slice: Phase 6 P1b — creator flat guide price UI (inert, flag off)

ci.note: Journeys workflow in progress at receipt time; deployment scope (metadata only) succeeded

ownerDecisions.P6: creator sets a flat price per guide, no platform minimum

deployment.newRoutes: GET /api/creator/guides/[id]/price (the existing PUT is now flag-gated server-side)
deployment.changed: creator studio guide editor price panel; studio write guard price exemption; ops payments status pricedGuides

production.step: the creator price route exists and needs a session (401 anonymous; 405 on the previous deployment)
payments stay disabled with no priced guide and no payment obligation
the owning creator reads the price surface while payments are disabled
a direct price write in production is refused while payments are disabled
a traveller can neither read nor write the price surface
production state is unchanged after the refused writes

honestLimits: No traveller-visible price and no checkout: setting a price has no user-facing effect yet; null means no price, not free.
The flag is read per panel mount; toggling requires a reload, and a hidden panel hides prices from the creator who set them while the flag is off.
Price is not versioned; changing it affects future acceptances, while existing booking_payments rows keep their amount snapshot.
The studio-bound guard exemption is verified by catalog definition and a local bound-guide acceptance case, not against stack-wide production content.
Live money remains P5: legal entity, Stripe account/KYC, payout bank, cancellation text and provider keys.
